icons.name: accessibility
icons.heading: Accessibility
icons.description: Everyone is welcome. Light: the figure dips, springs up 1.5 inside the ring and throws both arms up into an open V, lands with a hit and the arms drop back with a small rebound; the head trails the body by a beat. Strong: a deeper dip, a higher jump with the arms flung wider, a harder landing with two decaying bounces while the arms settle. The ring never moves.

icons.name: wheelchair-access
icons.heading: Wheelchair access
icons.description: The chair pushes off and goes. Light: the rider leans into a push, two speed lines stream out behind, and the chair pops a small wheelie back on its big wheel, then drops its front down with a hit and a small bounce; the head trails the chair by a beat. Strong: a harder push and a higher wheelie, a heavier landing with two decaying bounces. The chair stays rigid and ends exactly at rest; the speed lines are gone again.

icons.name: hearing-assistance
icons.heading: Hearing assistance
icons.description: Sound is carried into the ear. Light: the waves roll forward one step: the large arc travels on into the ear and fades as it arrives, the small arc swells into the large arc's place and a new small arc grows in from the source; the ear takes the arriving wave with a small hit and settles. Strong: two waves roll in, one after the other, and the ear takes two decaying hits. The waves end exactly where they started.

icons.name: high-contrast
icons.heading: High contrast
icons.description: The contrast dial flips. Light: the dark half winds back a touch, then sweeps one full clockwise turn through the inverted split and locks home with a hit and a small rebound. Strong: a deeper wind-up, the half snaps over to the inverted side and holds there a beat (light and dark swapped), then completes the turn, overshoots and settles. The ring never moves; the turn ends on the starting angle.

icons.name: reduced-motion
icons.heading: Reduced motion
icons.description: The ball brakes and its motion trails die down. Light: the ball lurches forward as it brakes and rocks back into place, while the three trails behind it retract to short stubs one after another, top to bottom, each snapping a little short and settling. Strong: the ball pumps the brakes twice, and the trails shrink in two steps, half way, then down to the stubs. The stubs hold; the reverse lets the trails stream out again.

Light: the ball lurches forward as it brakes and rocks back into place, while the three trails behind it retract to short stubs one after another, top to bottom, each snapping a little short and settling. Strong: the ball pumps the brakes twice, and the trails shrink in two steps, half way, then down to the stubs. The stubs hold; the reverse lets the trails stream out again.

icons.name: keyboard
icons.heading: Keyboard
icons.description: Typing makes text. Light: the three top keys tap down in turn, left to right, and with each tap a line of text above the keyboard writes on one more step; the line fades once the word is typed. Strong: deeper, quicker taps, then the space bar thumps down with a bounce, and the typed line lifts away as it fades. The keyboard body never moves.

icons.name: keyboard-shortcuts
icons.heading: Keyboard shortcuts
icons.description: A key combination fires a command. Light: the modifier keycap goes down and holds, the letter keycap strikes down after it, and three short sparks burst from the letter key as the shortcut fires; the letter key lets go first, then the modifier, each popping back up with a small rebound. Strong: both keys strike deeper with a bounce, the burst is bigger, and the release rebounds and settles.
